designer-initial.summary: Selected and audited a medium FCS scope preserving the full handbook FCS-to-FGS/AP allocation with 8 behavior-owning usages, 15 normalized semantic interactions (21 total connections), 20 contract cases, and 8 scenario families.
questions_for_model: Can paired left/right PFD boundary records be realized with equality guarantees and exactly the frozen 21 total connections/15 normalized semantic interactions, or does the current library require a localized root-port/count revision?
Can prior-state/next-state Reference and AP contracts plus AP-guidance-request and actuator-fault feedback be expressed without shadow state, using SyncPending to break the feedback cycle?
Can bounded analysis enumerate abstract attitude classes while remaining extensionally equivalent to the selected numeric safety, guidance, and actuator relations?

model-review.summary: Replace two non-informative internal interactions while preserving the eight owners and the exact 15/21/20/8 medium-tier metrics.

findings.evidence: PART-FGS-02 and PART-FGS-03 already receive the same QualifiedAttitude and ReferenceAndFdState facts. CASE-FD-01/02 deterministically fix FdProductQualification from those facts, FORM-FAIL-01 provides no independent FGS failure source, and CASE-APG-02 gives every unusable condition a higher-priority attitude/reference/FD cause. Thus FdProductUnavailable is unreachable and INT-FGS-06 adds no information.
findings.requested_change: Remove INT-FGS-06 and FdProductUnavailable; keep PART-FGS-03 deriving AP-guidance availability from QualifiedAttitude plus ReferenceAndFdState, and replace the edge with QualifiedAttitude from PART-FCS-02 to PART-APS-01 so AP locally distinguishes Unsafe inhibition from Invalid failure.

findings.evidence: FORM-ACT-01 and CASE-PROP-01 restrict every valid proposed rate to -50, 0, or +50, all within -200..200. Consequently CASE-GATE-02 cannot produce RangeFault in the composed model, INT-APS-04 is always NoFault, and that interaction cannot change PART-APS-01 behavior.
findings.requested_change: Remove INT-APS-04 and RangeFault-dependent AP clauses; retain PART-APS-03 as the publish/inhibit owner, repartition CASE-GATE-01/02 into accepted and inhibited outputs, and split INT-CROSS-02 into distinct AP-Guidance-Request and AP-active-clear-inhibit connections to retain 15 semantic interactions and 21 total connections.

findings.evidence: After those local replacements, all eight PART usages still derive classifications, combinations, state-dependent choices, numeric many-to-one proposals, or authority gates. None relies only on copying, bundling, renaming, rerouting, or a one-to-one enum/code translation.

The AADL library supports typed DataPort payloads and Data attribute fields, so paired PFD records do not force extra root ports. SyncPending and logical prior/next observations break the remaining AP-request/reference cycle. Exact bounded analysis must additionally preserve numeric saturation and deadband breakpoints; Safe/Unsafe/Invalid labels alone are insufficient.
findings.requested_change: Keep the boundary and state allocation unchanged; require attribute-backed record fields, explicit AADL imports, retained clean checker gates, and exact axis-wise numeric breakpoint coverage in the bounded analyzer.

designer-resolution.summary: Approved a localized interaction revision preserving the exact 8/15/21/20/8 architecture and authorizing Model regeneration.

model-generation.summary: Localized CASE_CMD_02 mixed-status conflict repair; added Sync, Display, and held-CWS disengagement oracles; refreshed source-bound analyzer, metrics, and traceability evidence; SysML typechecking and bounded analysis passed.

visualization.summary: Current-revision system-overview passed fresh Sireum validation, zero-finding health, native-resolution review, deterministic SVG/PNG export, and the complete 106-element/107-association trace audit.

designer-final.summary: Source, bounded owner-local semantics, traceability, and current-revision visualization passed; executable evidence is not required and not run.
